body.zh: 从 F1、WEC、WRC 到 GT 与 MotoGP，交流车手、赛道、轮胎与进站策略。从看比赛开始，走近速度背后的工程与判断。
body.en: From F1, WEC and WRC to GT and MotoGP, talk drivers, circuits, tyres and pit strategy. Discover the engineering and decisions behind the speed.

body.zh: 招新海报介绍了赛车模拟器体验与线下卡丁车活动方向。无论经验多少，都可以从第一圈开始认识驾驶与走线；具体安排以社团通知为准。
body.en: Recruitment posters introduce simulator experiences and outdoor karting as club activities. Start with your first lap, whatever your experience. Check club announcements for arrangements.

body.zh: 赛事前瞻、赛后回顾、公众号封面与社团视觉，让每个值得记住的瞬间留下来。也一起探索汽车工业、赛车技术与汽车文化。
body.en: Race previews, recaps, editorial covers and club visuals preserve the moments worth remembering. Explore the automotive industry, racing technology and car culture along the way.
